title: Drawing Fundamentals - Session B (55+)
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 18 – November 20, 2025 Thursdays | 2:00 – 3:30 pm | Age 55+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio 50 Victoria Street, Aurora This class (for participants 55+) will introduce technical and creative exercises to develop key drawing skills to use as you start your art practice. Courses tailored for adults 55+ encourage discovery, creativity and social connection in an environment that supports effective learning strategies for mature learners.
